title: Scalar loop control
intent: Establish the scalar control for summing eight runtime-derived values without a source collection.
focus: probe performs the same eight-value sum as cases 02–05 without constructing a list.

title: Bounded list consumed locally
intent: Positive control for existing intrafunction bounded-list promotion; inspect emitted allocation rather than assume it survives LLVM.
oracle: Eight elements n through n+7 sum to 8*n+28.
focus: probe constructs and reads one fixed-eight list entirely within the same function.

title: Bounded list passed to a reader
intent: Positive control for the strict borrowed-call promotion prototype, using a looped reader instead of a scalar leaf.
oracle: sum_values reads n through n+7 without mutation: 8*n+28.
focus: probe constructs the bounded list; sum_values is the ordinary list-parameter call boundary to inspect.

title: Construction helper returns a list
intent: Compare a constructor that returns its storage with the local and caller-created forms; measure the actual retained construction boundary.
oracle: make_values creates n through n+7; their sum is 8*n+28.
focus: make_values returns its constructed list to probe, which passes it to sum_values.

title: Caller-created mutable destination
intent: Exercise the proposed caller-initializes/helper-mutates pattern with the same values as the returned-list case; observe any inlining or allocation elimination.
oracle: The empty destination receives n through n+7; its sum is 8*n+28.
focus: probe creates the empty list before fill_values mutates it; sum_values reads the completed destination.

title: Runtime-sized list
intent: Control for a list whose capacity depends on runtime input rather than a small compile-time bound.
oracle: n values n+i for i=0..n-1 sum to n*n+n*(n-1)/2.
focus: probe uses n as the fill-loop bound, then lends the list to the same looped reader.

title: Bounded list above the promotion limit
intent: Control for a proven constant capacity whose 600 eight-byte integers exceed the current 4096-byte per-list promotion limit.
focus: probe has a fixed 4800-byte element payload before the header; sum_values remains a borrowing reader.

title: Read-only alias
intent: Observe whether a read-only source alias adds ownership operations when neither name is consumed or mutated.
oracle: Both names read the same eight-value sum, so the answer is 2*(8*n+28).
focus: probe keeps values and snapshot live across two borrowed reads of the same logical contents.

title: Snapshot retained across append
intent: Require preservation of the old eight-element snapshot while a new version appends a ninth value; expose real copy-on-write and lifetime costs.
oracle: Old sum is 8*n+28; new sum is 9*n+36. Weighted result is 10*(8*n+28)+(9*n+36)=89*n+316.
focus: probe appends after taking snapshot, then reads both versions; the weighted output detects snapshot corruption.

title: Snapshots retained across loop iterations
intent: Exercise loop-carried sharing and managed children by retaining every list prefix until after construction.
oracle: Prefix j contains j*n+j*(j-1)/2 for j=1..n. Summing prefixes gives n*(n+1)*(4*n-1)/6.
focus: probe stores each version in history before the next append; the second loop reads all preserved versions through sum_values.
